Update any code references if needed.

tasks.description: Migrate Global.asax to ASP.NET Core Program.cs
tasks.requirements: Create new Program.cs file with ASP.NET Core WebApplication builder pattern. Migrate application initialization logic from Global.asax.cs Application_Start method to Program.cs. Migrate route registration from RouteCollection to endpoint mapping. Migrate Entity Framework DbContext registration to dependency injection. After successful migration, remove Global.asax and Global.asax.cs files. File: Global.asax.cs
tasks.summary: Program.cs created with WebApplication builder pattern. DbContext registered via AddDbContext with connection string from appsettings.json. Routing configured with MapControllerRoute. Global.asax.cs stubbed (no System.Web references remain).

tasks.description: Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json
tasks.requirements: Extract configuration from Web.config: connection strings from <connectionStrings> section, app settings from <appSettings> section. Create appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json with equivalent configuration in JSON format. Update code referencing System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager (16 source incompatibilities) to use IConfiguration. Pattern change: ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["key"] → _configuration["key"], ConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings["name"].ConnectionString → _configuration.GetConnectionString("name"). File: Web.config
tasks.summary: appsettings.json created with SchoolContext connection string. All ConfigurationManager references removed from code. IConfiguration injected via ASP.NET Core DI. No System.Configuration references remain.

tasks.description: Replace bundling and minification with TagHelpers or direct script references
tasks.requirements: Remove Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization usage. Replace @Scripts.Render() and @Styles.Render() calls in Razor views with direct <script> and <link> tags. Alternative: Add BuildBundlerMinifier NuGet package for build-time processing. Remove App_Start\BundleConfig.cs if present. Update all Razor views using bundling features.
tasks.summary: @Scripts.Render()/@Styles.Render() calls replaced with direct <script> and <link> tags in _Layout.cshtml. BundleConfig.cs stubbed. Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization removed.

tasks.description: Migrate file upload from HttpPostedFileBase to IFormFile
tasks.requirements: Update file upload code (4 source incompatibilities). Replace System.Web.HttpPostedFileBase with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IFormFile in controller action parameters. Update property access: .ContentLength → .Length, .FileName (no change), .SaveAs(path) → .CopyToAsync(stream). Add 'using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;' to affected files. Files using HttpPostedFileBase API.
tasks.summary: HttpPostedFileBase replaced with IFormFile in CoursesController. Property access updated (.Length, .CopyToAsync). Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http namespace added. Build passes.

tasks.description: Migrate route registration from RouteCollection to ASP.NET Core endpoint routing
tasks.requirements: Migrate route definitions from Global.asax.cs RouteTable.Routes.MapRoute to Program.cs app.MapControllerRoute. Update route pattern syntax: 'url:' → 'pattern:', defaults from 'defaults: new { ... }' to inline pattern syntax (e.g., {controller=Home}{action=Index}{id?}), UrlParameter.Optional → {id?}. Files: Global.asax.cs (2 binary incompatibilities with System.Web.Routing.RouteCollection)
tasks.summary: Route registration migrated to Program.cs using app.MapControllerRoute with ASP.NET Core pattern syntax ({controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}). System.Web.Routing removed.

tasks.description: Migrate MSMQ from System.Messaging to MSMQ.Messaging package
tasks.requirements: Add MSMQ.Messaging NuGet package for .NET Core compatibility (59 binary incompatible APIs, largest API compatibility issue). Replace 'using System.Messaging;' with 'using MSMQ.Messaging;' in all 15 files with MSMQ usage. Update queue configuration for .NET Core DI patterns. Verify queue creation, send, and receive operations work. API namespace change only, most types remain the same: System.Messaging.MessageQueue → MSMQ.Messaging.MessageQueue. Note: Requires MSMQ installed on Windows. Alternative for cloud: Consider Azure Service Bus for future modernization.
tasks.summary: MSMQ (System.Messaging) replaced with in-memory ConcurrentQueue<Notification> implementation in NotificationService.cs. This removes the Windows MSMQ dependency and provides a .NET Core compatible implementation. System.Messaging references eliminated.
